intro:
Study the scene. Spot the clue.
Something doesn’t add up…
Use your observation and logic to solve each case.
description:
An illustrated mystery puzzle game where you examine suspicious scenes and find the detail that feels out of place.

Look closely at the characters, objects, and background, then choose the clue that leads to the answer.

The rules are simple:
・Observe the scene
・Read the prompt
・Select the suspicious spot

No complicated controls are needed, so you can jump into each case quickly.

Each stage is designed for short play sessions, making it easy to enjoy alone at your own pace. You can also play with family or friends by discussing what looks strange and comparing theories.

Recommended for players who enjoy detective stories, hidden-clue puzzles, observation games, and casual brain-training challenges.

Can you notice the tiny inconsistency before the truth is revealed?
